title: Chattree Plugin Manifest Schema v2
description: Formal schema for Chattree WebAssembly plugin manifests (plugin.json) with declarative inbound webhooks and event consumer pipelines.

$schema.description: URI to this JSON schema for editor autocompletion and validation.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version 2 supporting declarative inbound webhooks and event consumers.

id.description: Globally unique reverse-domain identifier (e.g., com.example.my-plugin). Must contain at least one dot.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum Chattree app version required to execute this plugin.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the plugin.

description.description: Short explanation of the plugin functionality.

author.description: Individual or organisation maintaining the extension.

authorEmail.description: Support or feedback contact email address.

homepageUrl.description: Project website, GitHub repository, or documentation page.

primaryCommand.description: Primary slash command (without leading slash). E.g., 'weather' routes to /weather.

aliases.description: Alternative slash commands invoking the default entrypoint.

type.description: Package origin and trust classification. Must be 'imported' for third-party plugins.

capabilities.description: Mandatory Host API capabilities required by the plugin.

optionalCapabilities.description: Capabilities requested on an opportunistic basis.

tags.description: Keywords for discovery in the marketplace.

changelog.description: Release notes for the current version.

entrypoint.description: Name of the exported WebAssembly function called by Chattree.

wasmPath.description: Relative filename of the WebAssembly bytecode binary within the archive root. Always 'plugin.wasm'.

wasmSha256.description: SHA-256 hexadecimal checksum of the plugin.wasm binary.

runtimeApiVersion.description: Target Chattree Host API ABI version. Must be '1.0.0'.

maxMemoryPages.description: Maximum memory limit in 64 KB WebAssembly pages (max 1024 pages = 64 MB).

timeoutMs.description: Execution timeout per invocation in milliseconds (100 ms to 60000 ms).

fuelLimit.description: Instruction fuel metering ceiling preventing execution hangs.

maxPayloadSizeBytes.description: Maximum message payload size in bytes (ABI v2). Default 12 MB, max 16 MB.

inputOffset.description: Static input memory offset in bytes for legacy ABI v1 plugins.

outputOffset.description: Static output memory offset in bytes for legacy ABI v1 plugins.

tools.description: Detailed definitions for individual commands exposed by the plugin.

settings.description: Configurable parameters shown in the plugin settings UI.

inboundWebhooks.description: Declarative local HTTP webhook endpoints provisioned for this plugin.

eventConsumers.description: Declarative subscribers to internal and webhook events.

id.description: Unique identifier for this specific tool.

command.description: Slash command trigger without leading slash.

entrypoint.description: Optional per-tool exported WebAssembly function name overriding the top-level entrypoint.

displayName.description: Label displayed in chat suggestions and toolbar.

description.description: Explanation of tool usage and argument expectations.

capabilities.description: Sub-capabilities specifically required by this tool.

intentContract.description: Declarative intent contract for natural language invocation without slash commands.

key.description: Key identifier used to read the setting via storage or config APIs.

label.description: Human-readable label rendered in settings UI.

description.description: Help text explaining the configuration setting.

isSecret.description: Mask input in the UI and store in device secure keystore if true.

id.description: Endpoint identifier unique within the plugin.

authType.description: Cryptographic authentication required for requests to this endpoint.

eventType.description: Canonical event type emitted upon successful receipt (e.g. webhook.alert).

requiredPermissions.description: Permissions required to receive requests (must include network.webhook_inbound).

eventTypes.description: List of event types this consumer subscribes to.

filter.description: Optional key-value filter evaluated by HostEventBus before dispatching to WASM (values may be scalars or arrays of allowed scalars, e.g. {"packageName": ["com.whatsapp", "com.whatsapp.w4b"], "canReply": true}).

targetAction.description: Exact tool ID or command invoked when the event fires.

requiredPermissions.description: Permissions required to execute the consumer.
